thesis: A high-return animal-health franchise with intact margins trades below its own 5-year minimum multiples, pricing near-stagnation, but companion-animal competition keeps the upside uncertain.
reason: Quality and cash returns are intact and the price sits below every own-history multiple floor, but companion-animal competition is real, the fair value is unreliable and there is no trend support. The scorecard lands in the hold band, below the add threshold: keep the position at its current size, no ADD.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2023 5-year low of 35.9%, showing competition is eroding profitability, not just growth.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2022 5-year low of 69.7%, signalling structural loss of pricing power.
TTM ROIC falls below 22%, a clear break below the five-year range, showing the moat's returns are eroding.
Companion-animal revenue declines operationally for two further consecutive quarters with dermatology cited in the 10-Q MD&A, or 2027 guidance implies a total revenue decline.
